model: Four spatial coordinates with independent time, explicit hypersurface toroid S1×S2 parameterization (coordinate degeneracies at poles), SO(4) plane rotation, perspective projection. Electrum outer tube. Separate exact three-dimensional incompressible resistive MHD benchmark B=beta*u, nu=eta, pressure=-|u|²/2 in Alfven units.
limitations: Fourth spatial dimension is a chosen abstract coordinate; MHD equations tested in 3D space plus time, not four-spatial-dimensional plasma PDE. Electrum is geometry only, no conductivity boundary condition. Z184 symbolic. Browser rendering and Pages not verified.
